reason: You want almost a million pesos a year from me on a 12-month lock-in, right after a slow quarter, for a simulation from a company with zero customer results. On top of that, the brands propose and pay for most of our displays, so I'm not the one moving most of these shelves anyway.
objection: A simulation is not real shoppers. Why would I trust a model built from our CCTV over just running a cheap pilot in two or three stores the way we already do?
would_change_my_mind: A free or paid-on-results pilot in a few of our stores where the simulated prediction actually matched what happened at the till, with no 12-month contract until that is proven.
